caption: A single uncut medium close-up shot in a quiet studio. The same adult man faces the camera and begins a very slow clockwise turn. He has short black hair parted on the left, a trimmed mustache, warm brown skin, a small scar above his right eyebrow, and dark round glasses. He wears a forest green corduroy jacket over a white crew-neck shirt and a brass wristwatch on his left wrist. Smooth continuous motion, no camera cut, soft window light, neutral gray background, realistic cinematic video.
